informal_statement:
The functions \(A_3,P_3\) are continuous on \((0,1]\), differentiable on \((0,1)\), satisfy
\[
A_3(t)\to+\infty
\]
as \(t\downarrow0\), and
\[
P_3'(t)=tA_3'(t)
\]
on \((0,1)\).
reason: Source `CMVElementary.lean:114-124`: The record distinguishes continuity through the right endpoint from interior differentiability, divergence and the variational identity.
